title: Cognitive diversity and team-level determinants of audit quality: evidence from Vietnam
core_idea: Investigate how team-level characteristics—cognitive diversity, educational and functional diversity, audit experience, and team collaboration—affect audit quality in Vietnamese audit firms, grounded in cognitive diversity theory, human capital theory, and team effectiveness literature; empirical testing uses a structured survey of 198 auditors with reliability/validity checks and multiple linear regression to evaluate hypotheses.
tldr: Study examines the role of four team-level factors on audit quality in Vietnam using survey data and quantitative analysis to explore how team composition and interaction relate to audit effectiveness.
